# `undriven-signal`: Signal has no driver / 信号没有任何驱动源

**Severity / 严重程度:** `warning`

## English

### Cause

A declared signal is read or exposed without any continuous, procedural, or port driver.

### Risk

Its value remains unknown or tool-dependent, contaminating downstream control and datapath logic.

### Fix

Connect the intended source or assign an explicit deterministic value on every required path.

## 简体中文

### 原因

某个已声明信号被读取或输出，但没有连续赋值、过程赋值或端口连接来驱动它。

### 风险

该信号会保持未知或依赖工具的取值，并污染后续控制与数据通路。

### 修复

连接预期的驱动源，或在所有必要路径上赋予明确且确定的值。

## Failing example / 问题示例

```systemverilog
module undriven_signal(output logic y);
  logic missing_driver;
  assign y = missing_driver;
endmodule
```

## Fixed example / 修复示例

```systemverilog
module undriven_signal(output logic y);
  logic driven_value;
  assign driven_value = 1'b0;
  assign y = driven_value;
endmodule
```
